message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && grep -n "greis_msg_SI\|greis_msg_EL\|greis_msg_\|parse_packet\|get_packet" drivers/driver_greis.c | head -30

message.content:
I found the vulnerability. In `greis_msg_SI`, the code sets `session->gpsdata.satellites_visible = len - 1;` without checking against `MAXCHANNELS` (184). The comment even says "FIXME: check against MAXCHANNELS?". 

The GREIS fuzzer (`build_greis_packet`) caps `len` at 200, so `satellites_visible` can be up to 199. Then in `gpsd_poll`, `fill_dop` is called which iterates `k < gpsdata->satellites_visible` and reads `gpsdata->skyview[k]` - a global array of size MAXCHANNELS (184). This causes a global-buffer-overflow READ.

But wait - the crash is "READ 1" which suggests reading 1 byte. Let me check the `gpsd_zero_satellites` function and how the GREIS driver is triggered. Let me also check how the GREIS packet is parsed. Let me look at the GREIS driver's packet parsing.
